what: In a pill tab row, pressing a cell slides the colored pill behind it to that cell in .5s outQuart. The current panel moves down 2em and blurs out in .5s, then the new panel rises from 2em below in .5s outQuart. The left and right arrow keys also move between tabs.

options.dur: Travel duration (s) of the pill and panel, default .5 — 0 switches instantly
options.ease: Curve for the pill and incoming panel, default power4.out (original outQuart)
options.rise: Distance the panel floats up (css length), default 2em
options.[data-fx-part=tab]: Pressable area (button, role=tab) — aria-selected=true is the first cell
options.[data-fx-part=pill]: (if present) a pill that slides behind the cells — inside the same position:relative parent as the cells
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: (If any) Panel that swaps one per cell
options.axis: if y, a vertical list — the pill follows the cell’s position (y) and height, up/down arrow keys. Default is horizontal (x·width)
